summary.ja: 小規模な固定例で、index-1 DAEの後退Euler・Newton法、整合初期化、保存則と拘束ドリフトを比較します。 追加固定例：index-1 DAEの整合初期化と離散残差、Robertson保存制約DAEと公式IDA保存値、振り子の指数低減・拘束ドリフト・明示安定化。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Small fixed examples compare backward Euler and Newton for index-one DAEs, consistent initialization, conservation and constraint drift. Additional fixed examples: Consistent initialization and discrete residuals for an index-one DAE, Robertson conservation DAE and stored official IDA values, Index reduction, constraint drift and explicit stabilization for a pendulum. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

assumptions: For the index-one examples, the algebraic constraint Jacobian must be nonsingular on the selected branch and Newton iterations must satisfy fixed criteria.
Backward-Euler residuals use explicit differential and algebraic row scales. Consistent initialization and rejection of inconsistent input are checked separately.
The position-constrained pendulum is index three. Its examples use an underlying ODE and constraint-error stabilization, not a general high-index DAE solver.
Comparisons with stored official IDA output are distinct from newly executed Radau/BDF/DOP853 references. The IDA executable is not newly run.
units: Examples are nondimensional. Differential and algebraic residual rows use explicitly declared scales; their unscaled norms need not have the same units.
boundary_conditions: There is no spatial boundary. Algebraic constraints and consistent initial state/derivative data are part of the initial-value formulation.

next_deliverable.ja: 別のモデルや大規模化は、入力・参照・基準を改めて固定して検証します。
next_deliverable.en: Other models and larger systems require separately frozen inputs, references and criteria.

limitations.ja: 固定した小規模系と入力に限ります。Robertsonの粗い刻みは当初の時間精度・収束目標を達成しておらず、元のFALSE判定を保存して表示します。微分した拘束を使うODEでは元の拘束がドリフトし得ます。一般のindex処理・大規模疎DAE・任意入力の収束は未検証です。 上記の制限は既存配布版の範囲です。今回の追加配布版：単一の製造正枝・固定BE計算です。IDA実行や一般DAEソルバーの検証ではありません。 公式SUNDIALS v7.1.1の2印字行のみ。IDAの新規実行0、長時間の化学精度や一般DAE性能は扱いません。 この固定時間格子の漸近収束や元精度目標の全合格は主張しません。 投影・正規化・SHAKE/RATTLEなし。一般指数3ソルバーやシンプレクティック性の検証ではありません。
limitations.en: Scope is limited to small fixed systems and inputs. The coarse Robertson schedule does not meet the original temporal accuracy/refinement goals; those false decisions are retained and shown. Underlying ODEs based on differentiated constraints can drift from the original constraint. General index handling, large sparse DAEs and convergence for arbitrary inputs are unverified. The preceding limitations describe earlier editions. This additional release: One authored positive branch and fixed BE runs; no IDA execution or general DAE-solver qualification. Only two official SUNDIALS v7.1.1 printed rows; zero new IDA executions, with no long-time chemistry or general DAE-performance claim. No asymptotic-convergence or all-original-accuracy-goals claim is made for this fixed schedule. No projection, normalization or SHAKE/RATTLE; no general index-three-solver or symplecticity claim.

metadata_review.level: Small fixed-input educational implementation; canonical source and independently extracted ZIP verification are required before promotion. Original unmet accuracy goals remain explicit; source review is limited to the selected official sections and stored-output evidence.

supplemental_review.level: Frozen fixed inputs, independently reviewed references and criteria, actual pytest/main and independently extracted ZIP. See release-specific scope and retained failure history.

scope.ja: 位置拘束の指数3系から明示ODEを導き、整合・非整合初期値の拘束ドリフトと安定化を比較します。
scope.en: Derive an explicit ODE from an index-three position constraint and compare drift and stabilization for consistent and inconsistent starts.

method_note.ja: 指数低減ODEと臨界拘束誤差拡張を固定RK4で積分し、拘束仕事も同じ段で積分します。 独自のスカラーNewton位置拘束、RATTLE終端接線impulse、SHAKE位置対。SHAKEの運動量は内部点だけで中心化し、端点を作りません。 SHAKEのsolves列はeta、eta/h^2、位置残差、Newton更新数です。列1は一律にeta/h^2ですが、初回半刻みの物理乗数は2eta/h^2、以後の位置Verletではeta/h^2です。逆位置対はすべて後者です。判定と図はこの列1を使いません。
method_note.en: Advance the index-reduced ODE and a critical constraint-error extension with fixed RK4, integrating constraint work at the same stages. Original scalar Newton position constraints, RATTLE final tangent impulses and SHAKE position pairs. SHAKE momentum is centered only at interior nodes; endpoint momenta are absent. SHAKE solves columns are eta, eta/h^2, position residual and Newton updates. Column1 uses the uniform recurrence normalization eta/h^2. For the first constrained half-step startup, the physical multiplier is 2*eta/h^2; later full position-Verlet steps use eta/h^2. Reverse-pair steps all use the later recurrence convention. RATTLE has its separate five-column normalization. No scientific gate or plot uses SHAKE column1.
